# ClickVault Documentation

> ClickVault is a HashiCorp Vault database secrets engine plugin for ClickHouse.
> It lets Vault create short-lived, ephemeral ClickHouse users on demand
> (dynamic secrets) and rotate passwords of long-lived ClickHouse users on a
> schedule (static roles).

## Overview

- [ClickVault Documentation](/)
